# HWHDRPeakNits <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [World](Blitz3D-World)

</div>


```blitzbasic
HWHDRPeakNits:Float32
```

**Returns:** The peak brightness in nits, or 0 if unknown.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

A BlitzLLVM extension: gives the brightest value in nits that the display of the window can show as the system says it: the brightness of SDR white times the room above it. It is 0 where the display has no HDR, the system does not say, or there is no window yet. [SetGraphicsHDR](SetGraphicsHDR) uses it as the brightest value it shows.
